verdicts.reason: A reads well as a left-to-right banner: the jar is a strong hero and the headline is clearly dominant. However, the NEW badge is squashed into a flat ellipse and floats on its own above the headline instead of sitting with the product. Shop Now sits high on the right and doesn't line up with the headline, leaving empty space bottom-right. B shrinks the jar so far that the LUMEN & FIG label can't be read, and the NEW badge becomes a tiny orphan below the subcopy, which breaks the reading order. The headline is crammed against the small jar while the centre-right is a large dead gap, so the product looks trivial.
